name: Animator

sections.daily_work: Bring characters and scenes to life through frame-by-frame or 3D animation. Work on films, TV shows, games, advertisements, and digital content.
sections.learning: Animation principles (timing, spacing, squash and stretch), software (Blender, Maya, After Effects, Toon Boom), storytelling, rigging, and motion graphics.
sections.pay: Varies by industry and experience. Entry-level animators often start around $40,000-$60,000 USD. Game and film industry rates may be higher. Always verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Animation degree or self-taught, building a demo reel, internships at animation studios, participating in animation challenges and jams.

try_in_real_life: Create a simple flip-book or stop-motion animation with your phone
Try a free 3D animation tool like Blender and make a bouncing ball
Watch animated films and analyze the movement principles used
Research animation schools and online courses
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
